# KEYSTONE PLUMBING SUPPLY, LLC
## TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF SALE

**As published October 2019**

---

### 1. ENTIRE AGREEMENT

These Terms and Conditions of Sale establish the complete agreement between Keystone Plumbing Supply, LLC, a Virginia limited liability company ("Seller"), and Buyer, and govern all transactions between the parties unless modified by written agreement signed by both Seller and Buyer. Any prior negotiations, agreements, or terms contained in Buyer's purchase order that differ from or supplement these Terms and Conditions of Sale shall have no effect unless expressly accepted in writing by an authorized representative of Seller.

### 2. SHIPMENT

All orders are shipped F.O.B. the point of shipment. Title to and risk of loss for all goods transfer to Buyer upon delivery to Buyer, Buyer's designated representative, or the carrier selected for transportation. Buyer shall bear all costs associated with special packaging or handling necessitated by Buyer's specifications or instructions. Should Buyer request or cause a delay in shipment, or should Seller ship an order based on inaccurate, incomplete, or misleading information provided by Buyer or Buyer's agents, Buyer shall be responsible for all storage expenses, additional costs incurred, and assumption of risk during such delay.

### 3. PRICE

Seller reserves the right to adjust prices at any time unless a price is specifically confirmed in Seller's written quotation. Buyer will be charged at the price in effect on the date of shipment. All quoted prices exclude sales taxes, excise taxes, tariffs, duties, transportation charges, and other applicable levies. Buyer shall pay any applicable sales, excise, use, or similar taxes in addition to the purchase price, unless Buyer furnishes Seller with a valid, executed certificate of tax exemption.

### 4. DELIVERY

Seller shall endeavor in good faith to meet Buyer's requested delivery schedule. Should delivery be delayed solely due to Seller's actions, Seller shall pay for expedited shipping to fulfill the order. Seller shall not be liable for failure to perform caused by circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including acts of God, war, labor actions, civil disturbances, accidents, material unavailability, carrier delays, supplier delays, or similar occurrences. In no event shall Seller be responsible for special, consequential, incidental, indirect, liquidated, or punitive damages, losses, or costs arising from delays in shipment or failure to provide advance notice of such delays.

### 5. CANCELLATION

Buyer shall not cancel, modify, or change any order except with Seller's prior written authorization and upon payment of all applicable cancellation and restocking charges determined by Seller.

### 6. PAYMENT

Payment for all goods shall be due within thirty (30) days of the date appearing on Seller's invoice. Should payment not be received by the due date, Seller may declare Buyer's entire account balance immediately due and payable without notice or further demand. All overdue amounts shall accrue a monthly service charge of up to one and one-half percent (1.5%). Buyer may not withhold, offset, or condition payment on any basis other than Seller's performance. Third-party payments received by Buyer do not relieve Buyer's payment obligations to Seller. Buyer's credit application with Seller is incorporated into these terms. Buyer waives any right to offset amounts owed by Seller against amounts owed to Seller under these Terms and Conditions of Sale.

### 7. INSPECTION AND ACCEPTANCE

Buyer must inspect all goods promptly upon receipt and before use or installation. Any claims regarding damage, shortages, delivery errors, or improper delivery must be communicated to Seller in writing within five (5) business days following delivery. Failure to submit a written claim within this period shall constitute acceptance of the goods, and Buyer forfeits all rights to reject the goods or revoke acceptance. Claims for billing discrepancies or invoice adjustments must be submitted in writing within ten (10) business days of the invoice date. Any claims not timely received in writing shall be waived.

### 8. RETURNS

Buyer may return stocked goods that are not custom or special order items, provided that: (i) the goods remain in new, unused, and uninstalled condition, in undamaged original packaging with all components included; and (ii) the goods have not been used, installed, modified, rebuilt, reconditioned, repaired, altered, or damaged in any manner. All returns shall be subject to a restocking charge unless Seller agrees otherwise in writing. Custom and special order goods may be returned only if the manufacturer consents to the return, and Buyer shall reimburse Seller for any restocking fees, cancellation charges, or other costs imposed by the manufacturer.

### 9. WARRANTIES AND LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

**(A) Keystone Private Label Goods:** Seller warrants good title to private label goods and, for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery to Buyer, that such goods shall conform to their published specifications and shall be free from defects in material and workmanship. Buyer's sole and exclusive remedy for breach of these warranties shall be repair or replacement of the defective goods at Seller's cost, or refund of the purchase price if the goods are returned during the warranty period.

**(B) All Other Goods:** Seller warrants only that it possesses good title to all goods sold. All other warranties are limited to those provided directly by the manufacturer. Seller shall assign manufacturer warranties to Buyer and shall assist Buyer in pursuing repair, replacement, or other remedies for warranty claims made within the manufacturer's warranty period.

**(C) Services:** Seller warrants that services shall be performed in a professional and competent manner by qualified personnel.

**(D) Warranty Exclusions:** The foregoing warranties do not apply to goods damaged by misuse, accident, modification, inadequate physical or operating conditions, improper maintenance, incorrect storage, or faulty installation. SELLER MAKES NO WARRANTY THAT PRODUCTS OR SERVICES WILL COMPLY WITH ANY APPLICABLE LAWS, ORDINANCES, REGULATIONS, CODES, OR STANDARDS, INCLUDING REGULATIONS REGARDING LEAD CONTENT, EXCEPT AS SPECIFICALLY SET FORTH IN A WRITTEN AGREEMENT SIGNED BY SELLER'S AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVE. EXCEPT WHERE SELLER'S NEGLIGENCE HAS DIRECTLY CAUSED DAMAGE, SELLER SHALL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, LIQUIDATED, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES CLAIMED BY BUYER OR THIRD PARTIES IN CONNECTION WITH ANY WARRANTY BREACH OR PRODUCT OR SERVICE NONCONFORMITY.

### 10. INDEMNIFICATION

Each party ("Indemnifying Party") shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the other party and its officers, directors, employees, and agents ("Indemnified Party") from any claim, suit, action, or demand for damages to property, bodily injury, death, intellectual property infringement, or any liability, cost, or expense, including reasonable attorneys' fees ("Loss"), to the extent such Loss results directly from the negligence, willful misconduct, or intentional act or omission of the Indemnifying Party. This indemnification obligation shall not apply to Loss proximately caused by the negligence or conduct of the Indemnified Party.

### 11. INSURANCE

Seller shall maintain all insurance coverage required by law and shall not permit such coverage to lapse. Seller shall carry Workers' Compensation insurance as mandated by applicable state law, commercial general liability insurance with minimum limits of two million dollars ($2,000,000) per occurrence and four million dollars ($4,000,000) in the aggregate (including product liability), and automobile liability insurance with minimum limits of five million dollars ($5,000,000). These coverages may be provided through primary policies, umbrella policies, or any combination thereof. Upon Buyer's request, Seller shall provide a Certificate of Insurance evidencing compliance with these requirements and naming Buyer as an "Additional Insured" on a primary and non-contributory basis, utilizing endorsements equivalent to CG2010 04/13 and CG2037 04/13. Seller shall not be obligated to pay any premiums or fees for OCIP or CCIP type insurance programs. Performance and payment bonds shall not be required unless expressly specified in Seller's quotation.

### 12. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

Except as expressly provided in Section 9(D), neither party shall be liable to the other for special, incidental, consequential, punitive, statutory, or indirect damages, including but not limited to lost profits, revenues, capital investment, business opportunities, or business interruption costs, arising from the sale of goods or services. This limitation of liability applies regardless of whether the claimed damages result from breach of contract, breach of warranty, tort, strict liability, or any other legal theory.

### 13. SEVERABILITY

These Terms and Conditions of Sale shall be interpreted as though drafted jointly by both parties, and any ambiguity or uncertainty shall not be construed against either party. Should any provision be determined by a court of competent jurisdiction to be unenforceable, such provision shall be modified to the minimum extent necessary to render it enforceable, or if impossible to modify, shall be severed from these terms without affecting the enforceability or validity of the remaining provisions.

### 14. NON-WAIVER

The failure or delay by either Seller or Buyer in exercising any right or enforcing any provision of these Terms and Conditions of Sale shall not constitute a waiver of such right or provision, nor shall it affect the right to enforce that provision or any other provision in the future. No waiver of these terms shall be valid or binding unless made in writing and signed by an authorized representative of the waiving party.

### 15. DISPUTE RESOLUTION

The parties shall attempt in good faith to resolve any dispute arising from or relating to these Terms and Conditions of Sale through prompt negotiation between senior executives with settlement authority. Such executives shall hold a position at a level above the personnel with day-to-day responsibility for administering these terms. Should negotiation fail to resolve the dispute, either party may pursue legal remedies as provided in Section 16.

### 16. GOVERNING LAW

These Terms and Conditions of Sale and all transactions between the parties shall be governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which the goods are delivered, without regard to conflicts of law principles. Any legal action or proceeding arising from or related to these terms or any transaction shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts located in such jurisdiction. Each party hereby consents to the jurisdiction and venue of such courts and waives any objection to venue or claim of inconvenience. The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods shall not apply to these terms or any transaction.
